Style Characteristics

A 103° Curved Peak produces:

Softer appearance than an RL Peak.
Stronger visual sweep than a standard peak.
Longer lapel line toward the waist.
Typical of high-end Italian bespoke houses such as Caraceni, Rubinacci, and some Cifonelli-inspired patterns.
Most flattering when paired with 11.5-12.5 cm lapel widths and a slightly suppressed waist.
